name: Laos

flag.description: Three horizontal bands of red, blue and red, with the blue band twice as tall as each red one, and a white disc in the centre.
flag.symbolism: Red represents the blood shed for independence and blue the prosperity of the country; the white disc is a full moon over the Mekong River and symbolises the unity of the people.

hook: Laos is a white full moon rising over the blue Mekong between red banks; Thailand has no disc, and Cambodia has a temple instead.
trivia: The design was first used by the Lao Issara independence movement in 1945.
It is one of the few flags of a communist state with no star or hammer and sickle.
Laos is the most heavily bombed country per capita in history, from the 1964–1973 air campaign.
